# 00000002794

**AG3-24 ★** — source: 78_渐近几何_Banach局部理论II.md

**English.** Definition: Local rigidity of Orlicz spaces: classification of subspace structure. Conjecture: The complete classification of Orlicz subspaces: Orlicz subspaces containing no ℓ_p copy are generated by compression bases, with the compression rate piecewise linear in the inflection points of the Young function. (Orlicz subspace classification)

**中文。** 定义：Orlicz 空间的局部刚性：子空间结构的分类。猜想：Orlicz 子空间的完全分类：不含 ℓ_p 副本的 Orlicz 子空间为压缩基生成的且基的压缩率按 Young 函数的拐点分段线性。（Orlicz 子空间分类）
